proves.claim: A builder self-accept on an item frozen with a low row that main now writes as team or critical is refused PENDING_REFREEZE, naming the row and pullboard refreeze.

cli.io-commands-verify.raised-stakes-sel.why: Without it a low-stakes self-accept sealed on the old record would land on a row whose stakes rose on main since the claim.

proves.claim: The raised-stakes check leaves an independent verifier accept alone, and a self-accept after the refreeze meets the ordinary team-row SELF_VERIFY refusal.

cli.io-commands-verify.raised-stakes-sco.why: Without it the check could block independent review or hide the ordinary self-verify rule after a refreeze.
